name: B10-0516/2025 (Renew) – Political situation in Myanmar including the humanitarian crisis of the Rohingya
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the political situation in Myanmar including the humanitarian crisis of the Rohingya
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for Myanmar's military leaders to be condemned for taking power by force and for the crisis they caused. It asks for the release of political prisoners, an end to forced conscription, and fair elections open to all parties. It wants more aid for Rohingya refugees in Bangladesh, more sanctions on the military, and a global arms embargo. It also criticises Russia and China for backing the junta.

- The Parliament asks for more sanctions, an arms embargo and more refugee aid; this is a request, not a law.
- It affects Myanmar's military leaders, Rohingya refugees in Bangladesh, and the EU's trading and aid ties.
- Next, the resolution goes to the EU Commission, Council and other named bodies; they decide whether to act.
